what: the corpus lane's lists of the spaces our own build made in a provider's text, kept here byte for byte in the folders the lane keeps them in: for each served text that holds one, the places that close at print. One entry per relay, and each list is read with the receipt of its own relay

never_closed.what: the served texts of the same source that lost a word of the provider's, with the places where a space stands for it: the provider's own space, which no list closes

note: every sha256 here is the one the relay's letter names for the file, and the bytes taken hash to it; each receipt names its lists by the same sha256, and names the source key and m id of each. The second relay's receipt says of the Wikisource Strong's that none of its served texts holds a made space, so it has no list
